footerPhrases: A little love, a little magic
intro: Andrea, Sara, and a little dachshund named Akamaru. Our favourite kind of family. Now, one beautiful day to celebrate with the people we love.
story: Every love story is made of small moments: a walk together, a shared laugh, and coming home to the same wagging tail. On 20 May 2027, we’ll begin a new chapter at Villa Valentina. Our story will soon find its words here; for now, we’re just happy you’ll be part of it.

faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Garden party elegant. Think summer colours and comfortable shoes for the garden. Bring a light layer for the evening.

faqs.question: How do I get there?
faqs.answer: You’ll find driving directions, train information and a map below. Details of our partner hotel will follow.

faqs.question: Can I bring a plus-one or children?
faqs.answer: Your invitation includes the number of places reserved for your party. If you have any questions, please get in touch.

faqs.question: A note on gifts
faqs.answer: Having you with us is the best gift. Your love, laughter, and company are all we’re wishing for.

travel.title: See you at Villa Valentina.
travel.intro: A historic villa in Tradate, with a courtyard, portico and rooms full of character. The perfect setting for the beginning of our next chapter.
travel.carText: Set your navigation to Villa Valentina, Via Donizetti 17, Tradate (VA). Coming from Milan, Varese or Como, use the live route below for current traffic and the best approach. We’ll share arrival and parking arrangements closer to the day.
travel.trainText: Trenord’s Milano Cadorna–Saronno–Varese line serves Tradate. Plan your train to Tradate, then arrange a taxi or a lift to the villa in advance. Check connections and the return journey near the wedding date; the May 2027 timetable is not yet confirmed.
